title: XFX Swift AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC Dual Fan Gaming Edition 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card $745 Delivered @ Shopping Express
body:
Deal: XFX Swift AMD Radeon RX 9070 OC Dual Fan Gaming Edition 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card $745 Delivered @ Shopping Express

[brocky2006] I thought cards were meant to go up in price.
[pineapplepears] My assumption is because of ram going up, less can afford to build PC’s so the need for GPU’s is slightly decreasing
[freefall101] Yup, seems like there’s tonnes of existing stock and contracts to get through first. Much like Apple just getting to increasing prices now.
AMD is reportedly going to rise prices by 10% this month, but even that will take a little while to trickle through.
[YourDailySupport] Data Centres: ur straight up wrong. AMD datacenter GPU revenue is up 22% YoY, 7 of top 10 AI companies use AMD Instinct. Different chip than the 9070 XT anyway.
Local LLM: wrong for 2026. ROCm 7.2 (March 2026) added full RDNA4 support 9070 XT does ~90 tok/s on Llama 3.1 8B, usable now.
Rendering: half right. Octane is CUDA-only, true. But Blender Cycles and Redshift both support AMD via HIP so "pretty much every renderer" is false.
Emulation/dual-boot: backwards logic. AMD's Linux driver is actually excellent (open-source, beats Windows by 13-17% FPS in some games) that's not evidence of bad drivers.
[Deviner] Emulation is a nonsense point here, if we're talking game emulation.
Only maybe on utter dogshit, old GPUs would FPS be an issue emulating stuff, to the point where you'd genuinely consider the ball ache of dual booting purely for emulation.
With emus like Eden etc, and Vulkan, it's a non-issue.
I've an 8840U which has a 780m iGPU and it runs every game I've tried at 60fps on battery…
TLDR only buy an AMD GPU if you are interested in normal gaming. They are basically DOA for other uses. And that is why they are cheaper. It's a gamer card for gamers ONLY.
Normal gaming…. ie. the super majority of people on this page looking at GPUs.
[Franc-T] I've an 8840U which has a 780m iGPU and it runs every game I've tried at 60fps on battery…
I have a similar AMD chip and no way does it run everything at 60fps
[Frackingiscool] @Franc-T: Minesweeper, Solitaire and Uno are a heck of a library though for 6fos gaming….
[Deviner] @Franc-T: What are you playing and what emu you using?
And what is "similar" to the 8840u that you're using?
Recently, I've been using Eden and playing Zelda Links Awakening at 60fps without a hitch (on a OneXPlayer X1 Mini).
But FPS varies wildly depending on which emu you're using.
That's not an AMD thing, that's an emu thing.
Also, I never claimed "every emulated game runs at 60fps on an 8840u".
I said "every game I've tried".
[Franc-T] @Deviner: 8845HS. Ok, if you are running a really curated list of games……or something thats resolution is really low mabye.
[hollykryten] This is probably from older stock that's been out the back of the warehouse for a while.
[FujinShu] Well Nvidia cards haven’t really gone down as much as Radeons, probably bc of consumer card production cuts to reallocate to enterprise cards.
[maverickjohn] Honestly if you haven't bought a ps5 already. I probably wouldn't be buying one now.
I own a ps5 pro and I enjoy it. But with the recent announcement of discless media. I would hold off support until they fix the issue. Buying after the announcement acts like support for their decision making.
If you are in a really rush to get a console i'd build an itx PC even with the ram spike it's still better off financially than going down ps5
Free online play on all gaming platforms on PC apart for Xbox, free games from Amazon Luna and epic. Owning of digital purchases made on steam etc.
[poiterbad] I was trying to pair something with this earlier today to reach the $1000 and save $100 as part of the other deal here
[dqtl74] Damn if only it was the XT. Still waiting…
[lijy85] I know it's not the ozbargain way, but I bit the bullet and paid $850… it's also 3-4 weeks of gaming for an extra 40-50 bucks!
[dqtl74] I don't need it desperately or anything, it's very much a luxury purchase for a secondary PC.
So I can wait hah
[tastycrayon] How is it better than https://www.scorptec.com.au/product/graphics-cards/nvidia/12… ?
[ttgoodman] Also, that 5060ti deal is nowhere near ATL.
[Count Shagula] Well the 9070 would make a better steam machine than the nvidia 5090 let alone a 5060. Linux drivers and all
[ReaperX22] What? They're not even in the same league. 5060 ti competes with the 9060 xt, not the 70 class amd cards.
[boozed] Bloody hell that's a bad deal for a 5060 Ti
[HeyThereJim] Is it worth trying to upgrade to a RX9060/70 card from a RX6700 if you're stuck with a previous gen MOBO (only PCIE 4.0, ryzen 5 processor, etc)?
It seems the GPU upgrade by itself would be a decent jump in GPU performance, for instance I feel like it would allow a lot more 1440p gaming and media watching, but not being able to go up to DDR5 ram and a better processor is going to really stonewall getting the best out of this level of GPU?
[JMxoxo] When you game, is the cpu at max utilisation or the gpu? It also varies heavily upon the game too.
I don’t think it would be too much of a bottleneck for the most part. Although yes, it will be the bottleneck of your system if you upgraded the gpu.
But ultimately, if you need a gpu upgrade and this ticks the boxes, get it.
[Erwark] Ryzen 5 is a very broad category. A 1400 would be a massive bottleneck, but a 5600 would probably be okay with a 9060/XT.
[HeyThereJim] Thanks. I should've been more specific re: processor. I meant something like an AMD 5600 or 5600x.
[ReaperX22] PCIE 4.0 vs 5.0 is negligible.
Ryzen 5 is vague; if you're a 5000 series you're fine to upgrade, you won't really be held back per se. If you're 1/2000 series it'd be worth considering a 5800X3D (anniversary) but I can't recommend it at the price tbh.
[Eiensama] I'm in the identical situation. Have r7 5700x and RX 6700 10GB. Have been HODLing so far, but become very tempted by 9060xt/9070 price drops. Hopefully the 9070 GRE will slot in between them at an attractive price 🤞
